syntax.syntax_item: R = tessera.reaction_diffusion(sz, steps, feed, kill, seed)

param_input_item.param_description: Field size: a scalar for a square field, or a [rows cols] vector.
Feed rate of the Gray-Scott model (default 0.055).
Kill rate of the Gray-Scott model (default 0.062).
Seed of the pseudo-random generator (default 0). The same seed reproduces the same field.

param_output_item.param_description: The generated field, a rows-by-cols double matrix normalized to [0, 1].

description.p: Simulate the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system from a few random seed patches. Two virtual chemicals diffuse and react, self-organizing into spots, stripes, mazes and mitosis-like patterns depending on feed and kill. The normalized final concentration is returned in [0, 1].

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: R = tessera.reaction_diffusion(256, 4000, 0.055, 0.062, 1); imagesc(R); axis image off; colormap(tessera.colormap('ice'))
